compression_scope: Per-member gzip values are estimates for disjoint group contributions, not actual chunk transfer totals, because compression boundaries differ. Actual transfer_by_file comes from checked recovery manifest.
scope: Read existing actual PCK directory and member bytes; no engine, gameplay, source or deployment changes.

interpretation.current_loader: All chunks of both WASM and complete PCK finish and hash before engine.init; no lazy asset downloading. Only two chunk workers.
interpretation.required_initial: Actual city/terrain inputs and needed terrain caches, street standard male/female avatars, native production scripts and interactions, Korean font, stone shaders, source SHA inputs. Saved nonstandard customization requires selected model pack before applying it.
interpretation.deferred_feature_preserving: Gallery models, optional body profiles and swim models can be separate resource packs fetched/mounted before each first use; keep raw assets and import remaps within packs so FileAccess SHA and load() still agree.
interpretation.terrain: All current cache files are uncompressed RSRC. Do not delete caches: runtime synchronously projects terrain and deleting makes cold CPU work worse. Compressing staged .res via ResourceSaver.FLAG_COMPRESS can reduce unpacked PCK memory without changing decoded arrays or dependency keys; it requires semantic equality and real Web checks.
interpretation.raw_vs_imported: Raw GLBs are separate from engine-imported .scn; runtime loads .scn via import remap but reads source GLB SHA. Dropping raw files would invalidate 213-file evidence and runtime snapshots. Preserve raw bytes with resource-pack storage or change contract explicitly.
interpretation.geometry_vs_textures: Example male street GLB7,883,300B contains mesh attributes5,917,536B+indices1,846,032B versus images98,499B; female swim GLB11,030,160B contains attributes8,285,184B+indices2,629,200B versus images96,899B. Main GLB footprint is geometry, not source PNG resolution.
interpretation.storage_compression: PCKPacker exposes no whole-pack compression option. Godot officially supports ZIP resource packs, which transparently decompress member reads and may preserve the exact raw SHA while reducing stored in-memory pack size; actual Web template support/startup must be prototyped. ZIP requires .zip/.pcz extension in official source, so do not rename ZIP to .pck.
interpretation.scope_limit: Savings and deferred groups are static audit estimates, not a tested new build or deployment. Active-only terrain-cache pruning requires current runtime hit/miss census; historical captures do not establish it.
